mutation_score_claim: A mutation score measures how many injected changes the current tests detect. It is not a measure of contract coverage, and no score is emitted here. A survivor is a question about the oracle, not a failure of the implementation.
unavailable: no mutation results were supplied to this run, so no survivor was classified and no equivalence was decided. This is a missing channel, not a suite with no gaps: mutation execution belongs to a stage that can build and run the target.
